title: Decoding an encoded transition action
statement: For every natural number $k$, every natural number $n$, every action of a machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and every Boolean string $x$, reading the serialization of that action followed by $x$ returns the action and the suffix $x$.
